narrative.overview:
Journey atlas connects a repair process through clear milestones, a visible approval pause, and a calm route ground. Broad destination lettering and silver-car illustrations give the system its character; live text carries the information.

This documents the approved marketing surface and its scoped customer-case extension. The existing /case index and /cases/[caseId] customer dossier share the cobalt and cool-paper case shell. Other application routes retain their established system; this extension does not authorize a wider restyle. The approved Option C composition remains defined in docs/CUSTOMER-CASE-BRIEF.md.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt, mineral ground, and a gold approval pause.
Illustrations paired with readable semantic text.
The customer dossier reuses the case palette in a document-led layout.

rules.name: The Approval Rule
rules.body: Gold makes the approval boundary visible without implying that approval has occurred.

rules.name: The Live Text Rule
rules.body: Headlines, process labels, and controls remain semantic text rather than being baked into illustrations.

rules.name: The Reading Order Rule
rules.body: Responsive layout preserves the meaning and sequence of the content in the document.

rules.name: The Scoped Case Rule
rules.body: Use the cobalt and cool-paper case system through the existing CaseLayout only for /case and /cases/[caseId].

dos: Do preserve a visible approval boundary.
Do keep labels readable and semantic.
Do retain keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
Do preserve the case shell's Alexandria typography and phone reading order.
donts: Don't imply live vehicle tracking through decorative route notation.
Don't use illustration text as a substitute for accessible content.
Don't extend the case route styling to other application routes without a separate request.
Don't treat the Demo label or this design reference as authorization for live payments, bookings, or operational actions.
